name: @unlayer-internal/template-loader
description: What loading a template needs and has no resolution policy of its own: the tsconfig a template compiles with, finding templates in a folder, reading a module's template and its PreviewProps, and guarding a run from a template's process.exit and late throws. Bundled into @hyper-elements/migrate and @hyper-elements/cli (tsup's noExternal), never installed on its own.
